1900-typee-a-romance-of-the-south-seas.title: Typee A Romance Of The South Seas
1900-typee-a-romance-of-the-south-seas.creator: Herman Melville
1900-typee-a-romance-of-the-south-seas.description: A book by Herman Melville. The great interest with which the important events lately occurring at the Sandwich, Marquesas, and Society Islands, have been regarded in America and England, and indeed throughout the world, will, he trusts, justify a few otherwise unwarrantable digressions.

19371-the-forfeit.title: The Forfeit
19371-the-forfeit.creator: Ridgwell Cullum
19371-the-forfeit.description: A book by Ridgwell Cullum. But its sufferings, under the rhythmic rise and fall imposed upon it, found expression at intervals, although they failed to inspire the least sympathy. The heedless giant's whole attention seemed to be absorbed in the personality and effort of his friend.

31039-punch-or-the-london-charivari-volu.title: Punch Or The London Charivari Volume 98 May 24 1890
31039-punch-or-the-london-charivari-volu.creator: Unknown
31039-punch-or-the-london-charivari-volu.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. _Miss P._ Who'd think we had such strong imagination! _The Soldier Doll_ (_aside to the_ Sailor D.). I say, old fellow, we have caught their fancy-- In each of us they now a real man see! (dubiously)._ D'ye think as we can _do_ it? _The Soldier D._ You stick by me, and I will see you through it. Sit up, and turn your toes out,--don't you loll; Put on the Man, and drop the bloomin' Doll!

arxiv-2207-13189.title: Inverse-designed Metastructures together with Reconfigurable Couplers to Compute Forward Scattering
arxiv-2207-13189.creator: Vahid Nikkhah, Dimitrios C. Tzarouchis, Ahmad Hoorfar, Nader Engheta
arxiv-2207-13189.description: Abstract Wave-based analog computing in the forms of inverse-designed metastructures and the meshes of Mach–Zehnder interferometers (MZI) have recently received considerable attention due to their capability in emulating linear operators, performing vector-matrix multiplication, inverting matrices, and solving integral and differential equations, via electromagnetic wave interaction and manipulation in such structures.

arxiv-2208-00454.title: An Inverse Problem for Fractional Connection Laplacians
arxiv-2208-00454.creator: Chun-Kai Kevin Chien
arxiv-2208-00454.description: Abstract . Consider a fractional operator P s P^{s} , 0 < s < 1 0<s<1 , for connection Laplacian P := ∇ ∗ ∇ + A P:=\nabla^{*}\nabla+A on a smooth Hermitian vector bundle over a closed, connected Riemannian manifold of dimension n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 .

arxiv-2212-13125.title: Applying triangular correlation of angular deviation in muon scattering tomography for multi-block materials via GEANT4 simulations
arxiv-2212-13125.creator: A. Ilker Topuz, Madis Kiisk, Andrea Giammanco
arxiv-2212-13125.description: Abstract The possibility to exploit the muon scattering for the elemental discrimination of materials in a given volume is well known. When more than one material is present along the muon path, it is often important to discern the order in which they are stacked.

arxiv-2305-17818.title: Quasi-linear fractional-order operators in Lipschitz domains Thanks: JPB has been supported in part by Fondo Clemente Estable grant 2022-172393. Thanks: RHN has been supported in part by NSF grant DMS-1908267.
arxiv-2305-17818.creator: Juan Pablo Borthagaray, Wenbo Li, Ricardo H. Nochetto
arxiv-2305-17818.description: Abstract . We prove Besov boundary regularity for solutions of the homogeneous Dirichlet problem for fractional-order quasi-linear operators with variable coefficients on Lipschitz domains Ω \Omega of ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} . Our estimates are consistent with the boundary behavior of solutions on smooth domains and apply to fractional p p -Laplacians and operators with finite horizon.

arxiv-2407-15408.title: Chronologically Accurate Retrieval for Temporal Grounding of Motion-Language Models
arxiv-2407-15408.creator: Kent Fujiwara, Mikihiro Tanaka, Qing Yu
arxiv-2407-15408.description: Abstract With the release of large-scale motion datasets with textual annotations, the task of establishing a robust latent space for language and 3D human motion has recently witnessed a surge of interest. Methods have been proposed to convert human motion and texts into features to achieve accurate correspondence between them.

arxiv-2410-04864.title: Order of Addition in Mixture-Amount Experiments
arxiv-2410-04864.creator: Taha Hasan, Touqeer Ahmad
arxiv-2410-04864.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Taha Hasan, Touqeer Ahmad. In a mixture experiment, we study the behavior and properties of m m mixture components, where the primary focus is on the proportions of the components that make up the mixture rather than the total amount. Mixture-amount experiments are specialized types of mixture experiments where both the proportions of the components in the mixture and the total amount of the mixture are of interest.

arxiv-2501-05161.title: Modulation of nanowire emitter arrays using micro-LED technology
arxiv-2501-05161.creator: Zhongyi Xia, Dimitars Jevtics, Benoit Guilhabert, Jonathan J. D. McKendry, Qian Gao, Hark Hoe Tan, Chennupati Jagadish, Martin D. Dawson, Michael J. Strain
arxiv-2501-05161.description: Abstract A scalable excitation platform for nanophotonic emitters using individually addressable micro-LED-on-CMOS arrays is demonstrated for the first time. Heterogeneous integration by transfer-printing of semiconductor nanowires was used for the deterministic assembly of the infrared emitters embedded in polymer optical waveguides with high yield and positional accuracy.

arxiv-2505-07394.title: Correlated electronic structure of the alternating single-layer bilayer nickelate La 5 Ni 3 O 11
arxiv-2505-07394.creator: Harrison LaBollita, Antia S. Botana
arxiv-2505-07394.description: Abstract The recent discovery of superconductivity under pressure in Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates has attracted a great deal of attention. Here, using density-functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory, we study the correlated electronic structure of the latest superconducting member of the family: the alternating single-layer bilayer nickelate La 5 Ni 3 O 11 .

arxiv-2506-19181.title: VHU-Net: Variational Hadamard U-Net for Body MRI Bias Field Correction Journal: Medical Image Analysis
arxiv-2506-19181.creator: Xin Zhu, Ahmet Enis Cetin, Gorkem Durak, Batuhan Gundogdu, Ziliang Hong, Hongyi Pan, Ertugrul Aktas, Elif Keles, Hatice Savas, Aytekin Oto, Hiten Patel, Adam B. Murphy, Ashley Ross, Frank Miller, Baris Turkbey, Ulas Bagci
arxiv-2506-19181.description: Abstract Bias field artifacts in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans introduce spatially smooth intensity inhomogeneities that degrade image quality and hinder downstream analysis. To address this challenge, we propose a novel variational Hadamard U-Net (VHU-Net) for effective body MRI bias field correction.

arxiv-2601-16939.title: Approximate controllability on the group of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms

pmc-10594375.title: Decolonization of hospital patients may aid efforts to reduce transmission of carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales
pmc-10594375.creator: Brajendra K Singh, Prabasaj Paul, Camden D Gowler, Sujan C Reddy, Rachel B Slayton
pmc-10594375.description: Background: Multimodal approaches are often used to prevent transmission of antimicrobial-resistant pathogens among patients in healthcare settings; understanding the effect of individual interventions is challenging. We designed a model to compare the effectiveness of hand hygiene (HH) with or without decolonization in reducing patient colonization with carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales (CRE).

pmc-11546867.title: Characterization of the Coriolopsis gallica DyP for Its Potential to Biotransform Various Fluoroquinolones
pmc-11546867.creator: Karima Staita, Imen Akrout, Julien Lambert, Annick Turbé-Doan, Anne Lomascolo, Craig B. Faulds, Héla Zouari-Mechichi, Giuliano Sciara, Tahar Mechichi, Eric Record
pmc-11546867.description: Coriolopsis gallica (Cga) is a white-rot fungus renowned for its ability to secrete ligninolytic enzymes that are capable of oxidizing phenolic compounds. This study aimed to investigate the biochemical characteristics of a dye-decolorizing peroxidase named CgaDyP1 and test its ability to biotransform antibiotics. CgaDyP1 was cloned and heterologously expressed in Escherichia coli.

pmc-12590908.title: Malaria healthcare service utilization before, during, and 1 year into the COVID-19 pandemic in 20 sub-Saharan African countries using Generalized Estimating Equation
pmc-12590908.creator: Angwach Abrham Asnake, Gilbert Eshun, Augustus Osborne, Michael Sarfo
pmc-12590908.description: BackgroundThe onset of the COVID-19 pandemic disrupted healthcare delivery including malaria healthcare services in sub-Saharan Africa. There is limited research exploring impact of COVID-19 on malaria healthcare utilization. This study explores the trends in disruption of malaria service utilization across 20 sub-Saharan African countries before, at the initial onset, and 1 year into the COVID-19 pandemic.

pmc-12619968.title: Pervasiveness and Frequency of Retinopathy of Prematurity in a Tertiary Care Centre and Its Correlation With Birth Weight and Gestational Age: A Retrospective Study
pmc-12619968.creator: Supreetha Kumaresan, M Meera Devasena, Radha Annamalai, Adithya Tellakula, Venkat Meghana Bhimanadham, M Muthayya
pmc-12619968.description: IntroductionRetinopathy of prematurity (ROP) is a vasoproliferative retinal disorder affecting incompletely vascularized retina of preterm infants. It remains one of the leading preventable causes of childhood blindness worldwide. The incidence and severity of ROP vary with neonatal care standards, oxygen regulation, and demographic factors.

pmc-12729403.title: MicroRNAs as the critical regulators of ubiquitin-proteasome system through F-box protein targeting during tumor progression
pmc-12729403.creator: Iman Akhlaghipour, Meysam Moghbeli
pmc-12729403.description: Ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS) as a crucial mechanism for protein degradation is involved in regulation of cellular processes. Dysregulation of UPS can be associated with tumor progression by modulation of tumor suppressors and oncogenes. F-box proteins (FBPs) play a significant role in the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway (UPP) by targeting specific protein sequences and engaging in post-translational modifications, thus affecting various pathophysiological processes.

pmc-13361051.title: Serotonin in Cardiovascular Disease: From Pathophysiological Insights to Clinical Utility
pmc-13361051.creator: Aleyma Veliz Perez, Mihaela Badea, Elena Laura Gaman
pmc-13361051.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains the leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide, posing a significant and ongoing burden on healthcare systems. Early identification of reliable biomarkers is essential for improving risk stratification, diagnosis, and therapeutic monitoring. Serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine, 5-HT) has recently emerged as a candidate biomarker implicated in early cardiovascular pathophysiological processes, including platelet activation, vascular smooth muscle cell dysfunction, endothelial impairment, and intraplaque inflammation.

pmc-13398936.title: Hyperactive ice‐binding proteins stabilize cell membranes and improve resistance to dehydration stress in Caenorhabditis elegans
pmc-13398936.creator: Daiki Shimose, Kotaro Ozaki, Ryohei Kuriyama, Yuka Ikemoto, Kazuhiro Mio, Yuji C Sasaki, Tatsuya Arai, Sakae Tsuda, Yoichi Shinkai, Masahiro Kuramochi
pmc-13398936.description: Ice‐binding proteins (IBPs) are known to modulate ice growth and promote freezing tolerance and have recently attracted attention due to their cell‐protective functions under freezing or low‐temperature conditions. In this study, we demonstrate that IBP expression improves resistance to dehydration stress in Caenorhabditis elegans.

pmc-13459897.title: Clinical analysis of preoperative and postoperative anxiety and depression in patients with proximal humeral fractures
pmc-13459897.creator: Hongfei Qi, Zhong Li, Hua Lin, Shuai Ji, Chengcheng Zhang, Bo Wu, Bing Du, Kun Zhang, Ming Li
pmc-13459897.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to investigate the incidence of anxiety and depressive emotions in patients with proximal humeral fractures rehabilitation plans.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on the clinical data of 89 patients with proximal humeral fractures from January 2022 to December 2023.

pmc-13495431.title: Effects of 6-week change-of-direction repeated sprint training on explosive power, sprint, and COD performance in U19 basketball players
pmc-13495431.creator: Şakir Tüfekçi, Tahir Volkan Aslan, Yalın Aygün, Sacide Tüfekçi, Burak Canpolat, Cemal Gündoğdu, Göktuğ Norman, Hülya Berktaş
pmc-13495431.description: BackgroundBasketball requires repeated high-intensity actions such as sprinting, jumping, and change-of-direction (COD) movements. Therefore, repeated sprint training incorporating COD actions may be an effective strategy to improve basketball-specific physical performance.ObjectiveThis study aimed to investigate the effects of a 6-week COD repeated sprint training program on explosive power, sprint performance, and COD performance in U19 basketball players.
